propositions: When the epic-close bug screen encounters an LLMUnavailableError from the LLM provider, the exception is caught and degraded to verdict C ('unrelated') instead of propagating, causing a systematic provider failure to silently blind the caused_by bug floor with no aggregate signal in the verdict, sidecar, or exit code.

The completion verifier must fail closed (nonzero exit, ticket stays in_progress, error names provider failure) when LLMUnavailableError is raised during verification, consistent with the absent-provider path, rather than degrading open.

LLMUnavailableError and its subclass LLMConfigError must be re-raised from both the warm-call and fan-out paths in screen_candidates._row and from the outer advisory shield in run_screen, before the broad per-candidate and per-screen exception handlers.

Non-systemic per-candidate failures (malformed output, store read errors, non-LLMUnavailableError exceptions) must continue to degrade to C ('unrelated') to preserve documented degrade-open behavior for non-provider failures.
The --force-close escape hatch must remain available to bypass the completion verifier and allow an operator to force-close despite provider unavailability or other verification failures.
